Features

Everything your business needs for its books.

Invoicing

Issue invoices, track what is paid and what is due, and keep every document in one place.

Marketplace sales

Orders from Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada and your own shop land in one set of books.

Stock & purchasing

Tax reports

Financial reports

Profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow, ready any time for owners, management, banks or investors.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Who is PatuhData Accounting for?

Businesses in Indonesia of every size, from micro, small and medium businesses to enterprises, that want invoicing, stock, bookkeeping and tax reports in one app instead of scattered spreadsheets.

Does it suit larger companies?

Yes. One organisation can run several brands and warehouses, with role-based access (admin, finance, tax, warehouse and more) and period closing.

Do I need to know accounting?

No. Journals are posted automatically from sales, purchases and payments, and our team helps you during setup.

What about tax and Coretax?

The app prepares Faktur Pajak and VAT return worksheets from the same books. Official Faktur Pajak numbers are still issued through Coretax DJP.

How do I get started?

Accounts are set up by our sales team. Contact us and we will create your account and help you add your business data and opening balances.

Who is behind PatuhData?

PT PatuhData Solusi Nusantara, a software company based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
